assertions.subject: Sarcomatoid urothelial carcinoma
assertions.quote: The detection of epithelial origin should be demonstrated morphologically or by cytokeratin expression immunohistochemically.

assertions.subject: Sarcomatoid urothelial carcinoma
assertions.quote: Another criterion is the detection of immunohistochemical GATA3 expression especially in the sarcomatous component.

assertions.subject: Sarcomatoid urothelial carcinoma
assertions.quote: Sarcomatoid urothelial carcinoma is a biphasic malignant tumor with both epithelial and mesenchymal components, identified morphologically and/or immunohistochemically.

assertions.subject: Sarcomatoid urothelial carcinoma
assertions.quote: The sarcomatoid histology is frequently an undifferentiated high-grade sarcoma with spindle cells, round cells, or pleomorphic giant cells

assertions.subject: Sarcomatoid urothelial carcinoma
assertions.quote: Accompanying heterologous sarcomatous components have been found to be related to decreased survival

assertions.subject: Sarcomatoid urothelial carcinoma
assertions.quote: The poor response of sarcomatoid UC to chemotherapy has been confirmed by some other studies.

assertions.subject: Sarcomatoid urothelial carcinoma
assertions.quote: Sarcomatoid urothelial carcinoma presents at an advanced stage more frequently than CUC

assertions.subject: Sarcomatoid urothelial carcinoma
assertions.quote: Sarcomatoid urothelial carcinoma presents at an advanced stage more frequently than CUC and is associated with worse survival
